skill.summary: Automates researching, scripting, and producing 30 viral, fully optimized fitness videos monthly across top platforms in just 2 hours.

latestVersion.changelog:
AI Fitness Content Empire Builder v1.0.0

- Launches a powerful tool to research, script, and produce 30 viral fitness videos per month in just 2 hours.
- Simultaneously deploys 10 Apify scrapers across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, Google Trends, Pinterest, Twitter/X, Amazon, Google Search, and fitness forums for real-time fitness trend insights.
- Identifies the highest-performing, lowest-competition content formats and reverse-engineers strategies from top earning fitness creators.
- Auto-generates 30 fully scripted fitness videos monthly, optimized for views and engagement.
- Produces professional-quality videos using InVideo AI, complete with AI voiceover and platform-specific formats.
- Delivers a complete monthly content calendar with monetization mapping for fitness professionals and brands.
